## Changed

- Build GitFrame with Zig **0.17.0**. Building from source now requires this
  toolchain; prebuilt downloads continue to include the executable.
- Update dependencies to
  [Chasen v0.1.3](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/releases/tag/v0.1.3) and
  [Chasen UI v0.1.3](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-ui/releases/tag/v0.1.3),
  together with a Zig 0.17-compatible flow-syntax revision.

## Fixed

- Include Chasen's fix for correctly aligned asynchronous task-result storage.
- Use real temporary directories for child-process tests on macOS.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/compare/v0.1.7...v0.1.8
